checkpoints.title: From plugin collection to capability inventory
checkpoints.summary: Installed tools were reclassified by the jobs they can perform, their overlap, and the risks they introduce.
checkpoints.next: Normalize providers behind stable capability IDs.

checkpoints.title: Capabilities become the contract
checkpoints.summary: Workflows request media.image.upscale, design.product.audit, or research.seo.keyword instead of hard-coding vendor names.

checkpoints.title: Each repository keeps its source-of-truth boundary
checkpoints.summary: SuperSkills owns reusable capability semantics; SuperAgents owns execution and approval; gpt-plugs owns governed provider records; Content Universe owns lineage and asset provenance.
checkpoints.next: Create GPT-PluginOS as the cross-source compiler/control plane.

checkpoints.title: Selection is not authorization
checkpoints.summary: Provider ranking remains advisory until action-level risk, permission, approval, and execution policy accept the route.

checkpoints.title: Lock the AI toolchain
checkpoints.summary: A deterministic lockfile records source revisions, catalog hashes, schema versions, graph state, and benchmark snapshots.

checkpoints.title: No universal winner
checkpoints.summary: Providers are compared by capability and context across quality, latency, cost, privacy, provenance, output compatibility, and health.
checkpoints.next: Turn the architecture into operator-facing product surfaces.

checkpoints.title: The control plane becomes a product
checkpoints.summary: Static field-site pages communicate the system, advanced uses, and revenue model while preserving the distinction between illustrative demos and implemented runtime behavior.
checkpoints.next: Make the surfaces data-driven and runtime-ready.

checkpoints.title: Product surfaces become executable demos
checkpoints.summary: Provider, capability, policy, benchmark, provenance, and checkpoint datasets feed interactive browser tools designed to accept compiler output later.
checkpoints.next: Wire these surfaces to the real compiler and route projections.

checkpoints.title: The illustrated control plane becomes executable
checkpoints.summary: An installable read-only runtime now validates the graph, ranks providers, compiles route projections, audits overlap and coverage, emits deterministic lockfiles, and exports the same datasets consumed by Studio.
checkpoints.next: Add live source adapters, health observations, real benchmark execution, and SuperAgents/Content Universe exchange contracts.
